about_the_game:
Strike fear with style.

Customize your operative’s look with the REAPER — a techwear-inspired costume set fusing futuristic street fashion and cyber-demonic flair.

Adapt your style to the mission. Dominate the underground in your own way.

Included in This DLC:

  • REAPER Techwear (Customizable)
    High-tech bodysuit with layered harness, tactical boots, and glowing demon mask. Built for mobility, intimidation, and fashion.

  • Color Customization
    Choose your own color scheme - from blazing crimson to stealth black or anything in between. You're in control of the vibe.

  • Legwear Options

    • Full Tactical Pants for a complete combat-ready look

    • Exposed One-Leg Variant for bold urban flair

  • Sleeve Toggle
    Switch between long sleeves or sleeveless to match your character’s style or mission needs.

  • Oni Mask Helmet
    Detailed demon mask with glowing red eyes and horns. A signature of the REAPER unit.

  • Visual Detail
    Features stylized bruises, bandages, and expressive hair and accessory physics for that extra character depth. Mix with any other costume combinations to express the darkness of REAPER unit

Key Features:

  • Techwear Aesthetic – Functional asymmetry, tactical gear straps, layered components, and urban ops fashion.

  • Cyberpunk Energy – From masks to material design, a glows with futuristic menace.

  • Fully Modular Design – Mix and match sleeves, pants, and colors to create your perfect combat identity.

  • Works in All Cutscenes & Gameplay – Fully rigged, animated, and optimized for action.

Note:

This is a cosmetic-only DLC. It does not affect gameplay, stats, or balance.
